description: Deprecated: this evidence tool is no longer refreshed and will be removed on or after 2026-12-31. For building, use discover_daystruct_capabilities and compat_check. Given a product and version, return whether that release line is supported, in security-fix-only maintenance, or past end of life, with the dates behind the answer and the cycles you could upgrade into. A line with no published end-of-life returns undetermined rather than supported.
name: check_release_support
title: Check whether a release is still supported
